lines.en: label dormwarsfive2:
scene sky
The sky is blue and things are good! Everything is fine.
lines.zh: 天是蓝的，一切都好。万事顺遂。

lines.en: scene noonsky
The sky is orange, things are meh. A gradual decline.
lines.zh: 天是橙的，一切都还凑合。正在缓缓下坠。

lines.en: scene nightsky
The sky is dark, now things are bad. I wonder what comes next?
lines.zh: 天黑了，现在事情变糟了。我在想接下来会是什么？

lines.en: scene raincheck
An unexpected thunderstorm. It’s poetry at best.
lines.zh: 一场意料之外的雷阵雨。至多算首诗。

lines.en: I’ve never liked tercets. They always leave me feeling 75%% complete.
lines.zh: 我从不喜欢三行诗。它们总让我觉得自己只有 75%% 完整。

lines.en: Sekai was like that too, which is why she taught me to write in fours.
lines.zh: Sekai 也是这样，所以她教我写四行。

lines.en: It’s something I’ve carried with me throughout most of my life, even if it was shoved so far down in the depths of my pocket until recently that I forgot it was there.
lines.zh: 这是我在人生大部分时间里都带在身上的东西，尽管它被塞进我口袋最深处，深到直到最近我才想起它在那儿。

lines.en: It’s all shriveled and crumpled up now — like an old note with repeating initials scribbled along the bottom of it. But I can still make it out if I squint.
lines.zh: 现在它全都皱缩成一团了——像一张旧纸条，底部涂着一串重复的首字母。但只要眯起眼，我还是能辨认出来。

lines.en: It’s just a bunch of lines, really. M is such a strange letter. But {i}that{/i} comes in fours too. So maybe there’s something poetic about its existence I’m not quite comprehending?
lines.zh: 其实就只是些线条罢了。M 真是个奇怪的字母。但它也是由四笔组成的。{i}所以{/i}也许它的存在之中，有某种我尚未领会的诗意？

lines.en: And maybe if I hold this metaphorical note up to the sky, the rain will erase the text and I will never have to remember losing something I never wanted to begin with.
lines.zh: 也许，如果我把这张隐喻的纸条举向天空，雨水就会抹去上面的字，那样我就永远不必去记起某件我从一开始就不曾想要失去的东西。

lines.en: There’s something to say about a stray cat here. I just don’t really want to — nor do I have the energy to reach {i}back{/i} into my pocket at this point in time.
lines.zh: 这里本该说点关于流浪猫的事。我只是不太想说——而且在此时此刻，我也没有力气再把手伸{i}回{/i}口袋里了。

lines.en: But maybe, if that one has been run over by a car or eaten by a larger animal, I can find it within me to search for a new one.
lines.zh: 但也许，如果那一只已经被车碾过，或者被更大的动物吃掉了，我还能在心里找到余地，去寻一只新的。

lines.en: I hear the shelters are packed this time of year.
lines.zh: 听说这个季节的收容所都挤满了。

lines.en: scene dormwarsbartime1
: Well, well, well! Look who finally decided to show up.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，哎呀，哎呀！看看是谁终于舍得露面了。

lines.en: : Is it raining out there? You’re wetter than Osako after I break out the handcuffs.
lines.zh: : 外面在下雨吗？你比我掏出手铐之后的 Osako 还湿。

lines.en: : It is, in fact, raining out there. And I’m not the type to use an umbrella.
lines.zh: : 外面确实在下雨。而我不是那种会打伞的人。

lines.en: : Is that because you’re stupid? Or do you just think saying things like that makes you somehow sound cooler?
lines.zh: : 那是因为你蠢吗？还是你觉得说这种话能让你听起来更酷一点？

lines.en: : Don’t talk to me about trying to be cool when you’re over there just...being hot and...leaning up against a pool table.
lines.zh: : 别跟我谈什么努力耍酷，你自己就在那边……又辣又……靠在台球桌上。

lines.en: scene dormwarsbartime2
: Need I remind you of my condition, Arakawa? Leaning up against things is something I must do for my health. Being cool is merely a side effect of that, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 需要我提醒你我的身体状况吗，Arakawa？靠着东西是我为了健康必须做的事。酷嘛，我想只是随之而来的副作用罢了。

lines.en: : I’d also appreciate it if you wouldn’t so directly proclaim your attraction to me in public as it makes me nauseous. Please die.
lines.zh: : 还有，请不要这么直白地在公共场合宣称你对我的迷恋，那让我想吐。请你去死。

lines.en: : Can I at least get a beer first?
lines.zh: : 我至少能先喝杯啤酒吗？

lines.en: : No. Because now {i}I{/i} want to die. Your aura is already suffocating, the last thing I need is you wandering in like a wet dog who-
lines.zh: : 不行。因为现在{i}我{/i}想死了。你的气场已经够让人窒息了，我最后需要的是你像条落水狗一样晃进来——

lines.en: : Can you guys just fuck already if that’ll put an end to this bickering?
lines.zh: : 你们俩干脆直接上床行不行，只要能结束这场斗嘴？

lines.en: scene dormwarsbartime3
: Yes.
: No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Damn it.
lines.zh: : 可恶。

lines.en: : You want me to see if I can go grab a towel from the bartender or are you too cool for those too?
lines.zh: : 要我去找酒保拿条毛巾来，还是说那些东西对你来说也不够酷？

lines.en: : I’m too cool for those too. Let’s just get down to business. I know why you called me here.
lines.zh: : 那些东西对我来说也不够酷。我们直接谈正事吧。我知道你为什么叫我过来。

lines.en: : I’d sure {i}hope{/i} you know why I called you here considering we’ve had this meeting planned for an entire week. You still down?
lines.zh: : 我当然{i}希望{/i}你知道我为什么叫你过来，毕竟这场会面我们已经计划了整整一周。你还来吗？

lines.en: : To be once again treated as a piece of meat held over an open flame surrounded by twenty hungry high schoolers? You know it.
lines.zh: : 再一次被当成一块吊在明火上、被二十个饥肠辘辘的高中生围着的肉？那还用说。

lines.en: : I don’t know whether I should be impressed by your fearless march to death or mourn the loss of whatever respect I may have once had for you.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该钦佩你无畏地迈向死亡的步伐，还是该哀悼我曾经对你抱有的那点尊敬的逝去。

lines.en: : There’s nothing impressive about what I’m doing. I’m just the carrot on a stick Imani needs to cultivate camaraderie among the class I abandoned and left to her.
lines.zh: : 我做的事没什么值得钦佩的。我只是 Imani 需要的一根挂在棍子上的胡萝卜，用来在我抛弃、丢给她的那个班里培养感情。

lines.en: : Like it or not, the consensus shows that Dorm Wars just wasn’t the same without you last year. So thanks for volunteering to come back for a day.
lines.zh: : 不管你接不接受，共识就是去年的宿舍战争少了你就是不一样。所以谢谢你自愿回来待一天。

lines.en: : And just...{i}one{/i} day. Correct? You haven’t been bribed into attending a second or anything like that?
lines.zh: : 而且是……就{i}一{/i}天。对吧？你没有被收买去参加第二天什么的吧？

lines.en: : No. I have not been bribed into attending a second day.
lines.zh: : 没有。我没有被收买去参加第二天。

lines.en: That is a decision I willingly made without bribery. But I have promised to conceal it from Imani, so it will remain unsaid for now.
lines.zh: 那是我心甘情愿做出的决定，没有收买。但我答应过要对 Imani 保密，所以现在它还将保持不说出口。

lines.en: : I’ll say, Arakawa — as happy as I may look to have you coming back to school, I do wish it’d be for a bit longer than just a day.
lines.zh: : 我说，Arakawa——虽然看到你能回学校我可能显得挺高兴，但我确实希望那不只是短短一天。

lines.en: : You don’t look happy at all. Why don’t your expressions ever match your dialogue?
lines.zh: : 你看起来一点都不高兴。为什么你的表情永远和你说的话对不上？

lines.en: : That’s rich coming from you, Senpai. You wear the same expression even when you’re boning me. And, not gonna lie, it makes me pretty self-conscious.
lines.zh: : 这话从你嘴里说出来可真有说服力啊，Senpai。你连跟我上床的时候都是同一副表情。而且，说真的，那让我挺不自在的。

lines.en: : Osako has said the same thing about me. But being self-conscious is her default state, so I’ve learned to just expect and accept it.
lines.zh: : Osako 也这么说过我。但不自在本来就是她的默认状态，所以我已经学会去预期并接受它了。

lines.en: : Either way, there’s no need to thank me. This just gives me an excuse to be around all of the girls at once again.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，不用谢我。这不过给了我一个借口，可以再一次同时待在所有女生身边。

lines.en: : And it remains to be seen whether or not this will mentally impact me as much as it did at the Christmas party. Let’s hope not.
lines.zh: : 至于这在精神上会不会像圣诞派对那次那样冲击我，还得走着瞧。希望不会吧。

lines.en: scene dormwarsbartime4
: Best Christmas ever as far as I’m concerned.
lines.zh: : 对我来说，那是有史以来最棒的一个圣诞节。

lines.en: : Yes, nothing says “holiday cheer” like bending over for your superior. I’m glad to see you were paying attention at the last HR seminar.
lines.zh: : 是啊，没有什么比趴下来给上司干更能诠释「节日气氛」了。很高兴看到你在上次的人事培训课上听得挺认真。

lines.en: : They don’t even send me emails anymore. I think I’m either exempt or just fired and I haven’t heard about it yet.
lines.zh: : 他们现在连邮件都不发给我了。我觉得我要么是被豁免了，要么就是已经被开除了，只是我还没收到通知。

lines.en: : I swear, it’s like your class exists in its own bubble not governed by the rules of society {i}nor{/i} those which govern the school. I can’t help but be envious.
lines.zh: : 我发誓，你们班简直活在自己的泡泡里，既不受社会规则约束，{i}也不{/i}受学校规则管辖。我忍不住要羡慕。

lines.en: scene dormwarsbartime5
: Wanna trade places for a day then? You teach my class, I teach yours?
lines.zh: : 那要不要换一天试试？你教我的班，我教你的班？

lines.en: : I’m no longer envious at all and am back to wanting to die.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不羡慕了，我重新想死了。

lines.en: : Yeah. That’s what I thought.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我就知道。

lines.en: : So I just...show up then? Where? What time?
lines.zh: : 那我就……直接出现就行？在哪儿？几点？

lines.en: scene dormwarsbartime6
: We’ll be all over the school that day and you can show up whenever you want. But you’re not {i}technically{/i} needed until the third contest of the day.
lines.zh: : 那天我们会遍布全校，你什么时候来都行。不过{i}严格来说{/i}，要到当天的第三项比赛才需要你。

lines.en: : Which is what exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体是什么比赛？

lines.en: : A battle between Maya and Otoha to see who can be the nicest to you.
lines.zh: : Maya 和 Otoha 之间的对决，看谁对你最好。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. So you’re just trying to ruin my day from the very beginning then.
lines.zh: : 哦，好啊。所以你从一开始就是打算毁了我这一天。

lines.en: : Is that not my job as your lovable kouhai and best friend?
lines.zh: : 作为你可爱的后辈和最好的朋友，这不就是我的工作吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think so, no.
lines.zh: : 我不这么觉得，不。

lines.en: : Could be worse, Arakawa. I could be competing as well.
lines.zh: : 说不定更糟呢，Arakawa。我也可以参赛的。

lines.en: : Sure, but at least I know that when {i}you’re{/i} being mean to me, it’s because that’s the only way you know to express yourself.
lines.zh: : 当然，但至少我知道，{i}你{/i}对我刻薄，是因为那是你唯一懂得的表达方式。

lines.en: scene dormwarsbartime7
: {i}Or{/i} you have deluded yourself into thinking I care about you as you’re far too dense to accept that there are people out there who genuinely despise your existence.
lines.zh: : {i}或{/i}者你只是在自我欺骗，以为我在乎你，因为你蠢到无法接受这世上确实有人真心厌恶你的存在。

lines.en: : Everyone wants a piece of this and you’re a part of everyone, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 每个人都想分我一块，而你是「每个人」的一部分，Wakana。

lines.en: : I’d rather be a part of a group of criminals sent to death via firing squad.
lines.zh: : 我宁愿成为被行刑队处决的一伙罪犯中的一员。

lines.en: : Guys, seriously. I can deal with the emotional repercussions of you doing the sexy tango if it allows us to have a civilized discussion for once.
lines.zh: : 两位，认真的。如果能让你们做一次文明的对话，我愿意承受你们跳性感探戈带来的情感冲击。

lines.en: : You heard the woman. Let’s go.
lines.zh: : 你听到女士的话了。我们走吧。

lines.en: : Sorry, Imani. I {i}do{/i} attend the HR seminars.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Imani。我可{i}是{/i}有去上人事培训课的。

lines.en: : They still make you go to those?
lines.zh: : 他们还让你去上那些课？

lines.en: scene dormwarsbartime8
: Oh, Osako. I didn’t realize you walked in.
lines.zh: : 哦，Osako。我没注意到你走进来了。

lines.en: : Yeah, sorry. I got held up by the rain on the way back from the cafe.
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉。我从咖啡馆回来的路上被雨耽搁了。

lines.en: scene dormwarsbartime9
: And I assume Akira did too based on the fact that he is soaking wet from probably being too cool to use an umbrella.
lines.zh: : 而 Akira 大概也一样，他浑身湿透，多半是因为太酷了不肯打伞。

lines.en: : Imani is trying to ruin my weekend and your girlfriend won’t have sex with me. Please fix this.
lines.zh: : Imani 正试图毁掉我的周末，而你女朋友不肯和我上床。请解决一下。

lines.en: : No.
scene dormwarsbartime8
: Why am I so universally hated?
lines.zh: : 为什么所有人都这么讨厌我？

lines.en: : Anyway! I guess we can file the Dorm Wars preamble into the “completed” category and go meet back up with Rika at the counter since she’s been alone this whole time.
lines.zh: : 总之！我想宿舍战争的前置说明可以归类到「已完成」了，我们回去找吧台那边的 Rika 吧，毕竟她一个人待了这么久。

lines.en: : I’m sure she’s fine. I put on Dog TV for her on my phone before we came over here to play pool.
lines.zh: : 我肯定她没事。我们过来打台球之前，我在手机上给她放了狗狗频道。

lines.en: : Okay, yeah. That’ll do it. Osako, Senpai, do you guys want drinks? First round’s on me tonight.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那确实够了。Osako，Senpai，你俩要喝点什么吗？今晚第一轮我请。

lines.en: : I’m good for now, thanks.
lines.zh: : 我现在不用，谢谢。

lines.en: : I’ll have what she’s having.
lines.zh: : 我要和她一样的。

lines.en: : So...nothing?
lines.zh: : 那就是……什么都不要？

lines.en: scene dormwarsbartime10
: No, I’ve just always wanted to say that. I’ll have a beer as it may very well be my last.
lines.zh: : 不，我一直都想说那么一句。我要一杯啤酒，因为它很可能就是我的最后一杯了。

lines.en: : Come, Wakana! Let us rescue our elderly friend from all of the dogs on your cell phone!
lines.zh: : 来吧，Wakana！让我们把你手机里那一群狗从我们年迈的朋友身边解救出来！

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}we’ll be over there when you two are done touching each other.
lines.zh: : {i}哈啊……{/i}等你们俩摸完了再过来找我们。

lines.en: : Sounds good. Thanks, guys.
lines.zh: : 好。谢了，各位。

lines.en: scene dormwarsbartime11
: Come to think of it, why {i}are{/i} you touching me? You don’t touch boys. You’re allergic to them.
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你为什么{i}在{/i}摸我？你不碰男生的。你对他们过敏。

lines.en: : Yes, that’s what being a lesbian is. Achoo. That aside, are you actually serious about going through with this Dorm Wars thing again?
lines.zh: : 对，那就是同性恋的意思。阿嚏。撇开这个不谈，你是真的打算再去参加那个宿舍战争？

lines.en: : Yeah. Why wouldn’t I be?
lines.zh: : 是啊。为什么不？

lines.en: : Becaaaaaaaause you {i}very{/i} recently opened up to me about the fact that you’ve been doing heinous things with a lot of those girls and felt extremely guilty about it?
lines.zh: : 因为……因为你{i}前不久{/i}才向我坦白，说你和那些女生里的很多人做过很过分的事，而且为此感到极度内疚？

lines.en: : Technically, I didn’t say I was trying to stop.
lines.zh: : 严格来说，我没说过我要停手。

lines.en: : So you’re just...you’re just gonna keep putting yourself in situations like that then?
lines.zh: : 所以你就……你就打算一直把自己往那种处境里送？

lines.en: : Mhm.
: And you don’t have any problem with that at all?
lines.zh: : 而你对此一点问题都没有？

lines.en: : No, I have a problem with it.
lines.zh: : 不，我有问题。

lines.en: scene dormwarsbartime12
: Well, why the fuck did you drag me into this then?! Am I not supposed to try and talk you out of this shit?!
lines.zh: : 那你他妈的把我扯进来干什么？！我不该试着劝你别干这些破事吗？！

lines.en: : I just wanted to connect with you and I’m not allowed to do that with my penis.
lines.zh: : 我只是想和你产生连接，而我不被允许用我的阴茎来做到这一点。

lines.en: scene dormwarsbartime13
: Ugh. I almost feel like it would be easier if you just {i}did.{/i}
lines.zh: : 呃。我几乎觉得如果你真{i}那么干{/i}反而更省事。

lines.en: : I’m willing to give it a shot if you are, Osako.
lines.zh: : 如果你愿意的话，我可以试一试，Osako。

lines.en: scene dormwarsbartime14
: Akira, just {i}don’t do it.{/i} I’m off tomorrow. Come hang out with me instead. We can, like...I don’t know...take another weird class or something.
lines.zh: : Akira，{i}别去了{/i}。我明天休息。来陪我吧。我们可以，比如……我不知道……再去上点什么奇怪的课之类的。

lines.en: : Whatever we {i}can{/i} do to keep you out of a situation where you are {i}very likely{/i} going to fuck some high schooler.
lines.zh: : 只要{i}能{/i}让你远离那个你{i}极有可能{/i}去上了某个高中生的局面，干什么都行。

lines.en: : Hell, I’ll hire you a prostitute myself. She just might look and act a lot like Rika and also be named Rika and...probably just {i}be{/i} Rika.
lines.zh: : 见鬼，我亲自给你雇个妓女都行。她大概会长得很像 Rika、举止也很像 Rika，而且……大概{i}就是{/i} Rika 本人。

lines.en: : Rika’s not a prostitute.
lines.zh: : Rika 不是妓女。

lines.en: : I know that. But do you really think she’d say no to screwing you if I offered her like 5,000 yen for it?
lines.zh: : 我知道。但你真觉得，如果我给她五千日元让她跟你上床，她会拒绝吗？

lines.en: : Osako, I can’t just...not go. It’s an annual tradition. Everyone’s expecting me there.
lines.zh: : Osako，我不能就……不去。那是一年一度的传统。所有人都在等我去。

lines.en: : You literally just {i}didn’t go{/i} last time though, right?
lines.zh: : 可你上次明明就{i}没去{/i}啊，对吧？

lines.en: : Last time was different. There was a girl at home who needed me to be there for her.
lines.zh: : 上次不一样。当时家里有个女孩需要我陪在她身边。

lines.en: : But this year, she’s going to be there. And I already know that most of her classmates hate her now, so {i}I{/i} need to be there too so she doesn’t feel left out.
lines.zh: : 但今年，她会在场。而且{i}我{/i}已经知道，她的大部分同学现在都讨厌她，所以我也得在，好让她不觉得自己被排挤。

lines.en: : Cute story. Question, though. About what percentage of that is the real reason you’re doing this and what percentage is that you just want to fuck another high schooler?
lines.zh: : 故事很感人。不过问一下，这番话里有多少是真理由，又有多少只是你想再上一个高中生？

lines.en: : I’d say it’s an even split.
lines.zh: : 我说是一半一半。

lines.en: scene dormwarsbartime15
: Oh my fucking God. I seriously hate caring about you. You make it so fucking difficult.
lines.zh: : 我操你妈的。我真的很讨厌自己在乎你。你让这件事变得他妈的难上加难。

lines.en: : None of this would have ever happened if you just liked men. We could have done the penis stuff and been done with it. But no. You had to treat me like a {i}human.{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果你喜欢男人，这一切就都不会发生。我们本可以做那档子事然后一了百了。但不。你非得把我当个{i}人{/i}看。

lines.en: : Yeah. Silly me, right?
lines.zh: : 是啊。我可真傻，对吧？
